Top candidates: Bacterial_Wilt, Southern_Bacterial_Wilt, Verticillium_Wilt.

- **Bacterial_Wilt refs**: Bugwood_6 shows wilted tomatoes with brown foliage (more advanced stage). Bugwood_3 and _11 are bacterial streaming diagnostic tests.
- **Southern_Bacterial_Wilt refs**: Bugwood_14 shows wilted tomatoes on black plastic mulch, similar field setup. Bugwood_1 is a streaming test (Bugwood ID 5593855, very close to test image ID 5593858 — same series). Bugwood_4 shows vascular discoloration.
- **Verticillium_Wilt**: Shows yellowing/chlorosis on leaves — doesn't match.
- **TSWV**: Shows purple spots on leaves — doesn't match.

The test image pattern (sudden whole-plant green wilt, black plastic mulch, field setting, healthy neighbors) matches a rapid bacterial wilt. The Bugwood IDs (5593855 Southern Bacterial Wilt streaming test vs. 5593858 test image) confirm this is from the same disease documentation series. Southern_Bacterial_Wilt/Bugwood_14 (field wilt on black mulch) is the closest match structurally.
